set.body: Repair the reproduced Glasser hemisphere collision: volume ID 1 can mean R_V1_ROI while surface ID 1 means L_V1_ROI, yet current exact domains align. Specify typed parcel identity policy and checked canonical hemisphere/area keys. Known encodings must map labels to canonical keys; unknown mappings must not claim shared identity and require a checked locus4s bijection. Preserve explicit source-label-to-parcel provenance and display order, and legitimate Schaefer cross-representation identity. Version new key preimages without silently reinterpreting old publication identities; keep the fixed foreign-producer v1 protocol fixture. Acceptance: opposite-hemi/renumbered/reordered fixtures demonstrate correct alignment or rejection, malformed/duplicate/missing canonical keys are typed failures, publication restores and assignment source maps remain exact, atlas JVM and JS pass. Scope modules/atlas shared identity/realization/ref descriptors and Glasser loader plus focused tests.
set.title: Atlas: separate canonical parcel identity from source label encoding
